literal: Lover when absent, evening, at the execution ground enemies like, comes.
translation: When my lover is absent, the evening approaches like ruthless enemies at the execution ground.
modern: காதலர் அருகில் இல்லாத போது, இந்த மாலைப் பொழுது கொலைக்களத்தில் நிற்கும் பகைவர்களைப் போல என்னை வதைக்க வருகிறது.
explanation: The speaker expresses the unbearable agony of twilight when separated from her lover. The evening, which normally brings lovers together, is personified as a deadly threat. The word 'ஏதிலர்' generally means strangers, but placed in a 'கொலைக்களம்' (execution ground), it takes the specific sense of merciless executioners or enemies. This stark image conveys how the loneliness of the evening feels like an impending, inescapable death.
